CommunityApplications.Profile: featherdrop — a clean, login-free, self-hosted file sharer for Unraid. Open the page, drop a file, set an expiry (and an optional password), get a shareable link. Resumable uploads, files stored on a local volume, metadata in a single SQLite file — no separate database, no accounts. A lightweight alternative to heavier sharing platforms. Maintained by junkerderprovinz.
